verdict.rationale: Intel's own pages claim gaming capability for Core Ultra Series 2: more Arc GPU performance, XeSS 3 for 'ultra-smooth FPS on the go', and optimization tools 'for major FPS delivery'. These are family-level marketing claims, not 258V-specific, and nothing in the pack corroborates them. Missing for 10: independent game benchmarks with measured frame rates, 258V-specific cache and boost-clock details, an integrated-GPU class specification, and any hands-on corroboration of the FPS claims.

support.subject: As a gamer, this chip drives high frame rates in real games — vendor gaming claims (cache, boost behavior, integrated GPU class) corroborated by independent game benchmarks

citations.quote: More GPU performance from Intel® Arc™ graphics and AI-enhanced gameplay with Intel® XeSS 3 give you ultra-smooth FPS on the go.
Boost your favorite games with the latest technologies like Intel® Binary Optimization Tool and Intel® Application Optimization, for major FPS delivery.
Load up thousands of AAA and indie titles for a full gaming experience across Steam, Epic, Battle.net, and Xbox Game Pass.
